# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rules (Data Source)

Lists the firewall rules of a Sentry tunnel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_firewall_rules" "game" {
  tunnel_id = data.tcpshield_sentry_tunnel.game.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tunnel_id` (Number) Sentry tunnel id.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `end_port` (Number) Last port of the range.
- `filter_id` (Number) Protocol filter id.
- `human_name` (String) Display name of the rule's filter.
- `id` (Number) Numeric rule id.
- `internal_name` (String) Internal name of the rule's filter.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `start_port` (Number) First port of the range.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) Sentry tunnel id.
